title: fm-spec
subtitle: Schema viewer for the generative reference

search.platformStepHint: Show steps that run on this platform (incl. partial support)
search.platformFnHint: Show functions built for this platform (platform binding)
search.platformTriggerHint: Show trigger events that fire on this platform (incl. partial support)

detail.affinity_dedicated: Only meaningful results here — callable everywhere, degrades elsewhere

opt.label: Label (EN)
opt.invertedHint: Label semantics are inverted relative to the XML state — true_text/false_text already carry the complete text-to-XML mapping; never invert again.
opt.docOnly: Documented by Claris, but not roundtrip-verified — verify behaviour after paste.
opt.pasteDroppedHint: FileMaker discards this option on paste whatever its value — a generator leaves it out, the reference keeps the placeholder for reading.

grammar.knownBugHint: Known FileMaker bug — a warning class, not a validity rule: the step is valid, FileMaker's own serialization is the risk.
grammar.saxmlGapHint: SaXML export gap — the export never carries this slot, so a catalog built from it cannot show it; only a clipboard copy does. Not a defect of the snippet.
grammar.constraintCoverageHint: Applies to the FileMaker {{coverage}} serialization only
grammar.variableTargetMarkerHint: Carries an empty <Text/> step-level marker exactly when the target slot holds a variable instead of a field reference.

sk.hull: hull — persists with default content even unconfigured
sk.hull_strip_children: hull — keeps its attributes, unfilled children are stripped
sk.help: Elements FileMaker keeps in the snippet even when nothing inside them is configured; shown as the tree they form, in template order. A generator restores them after pruning unfilled content, a reader may drop their default content.

bd.suppressEmpty: empty element is never emitted deterministically (dialog residue)
bd.help: Elements whose presence depends on another option. Several values of one option form the set at which the element exists (or is dropped): the element is written for any of them and pruned for every other value.

mr.source_present: copy of {{option}} — written by FileMaker whenever the source is set
mr.help: Values FileMaker writes a second time at another place of the step and keeps in sync on paste. The source option is the truth: a generator copies it, a reader treats the copy as redundancy.

imp.help: Options the canonical text notation leaves implicit: a keyword, a reference form or a labeled mode implies the value of another option when the step is parsed.

grammar.coverageHint: FileMaker version whose paired export and clipboard evidence this shape is verified against. A row tagged with a version is an override of that coverage and replaces the standard row of the same key.
grammar.overrideHint: Override row of coverage {{coverage}} — replaces the standard row of the same key.
grammar.noOverrides: No override rows for this coverage — the standard shape applies.

saxml.hint: SaXML and fmxmlsnippet are two distinct representations of the same step.
saxml.sourceNote: The shipped data is source-neutral: it carries no source citations, author or company names, or corpus artifacts. Example payloads shown per step are synthetic.

compat.label: Platform compatibility
compat.partialHint: Partial — conditionally supported; see the step's Claris help page
compat.none: No platform — Claris lists this event as not supported anywhere

osAffinity.label: OS binding
osAffinity.hint_exclusive: Works only on the listed operating systems
osAffinity.hint_unsupported: Claris explicitly names this OS as not supported (source-true inverse statement)
osAffinity.hint_variant: Runs everywhere — behavior or result depends on the OS
osAffinity.hint_os_probe: Returns the platform/OS at runtime — guard idiom, not a binding

triggers.unavailable: This reference carries no script-trigger table (fm-spec < 1.18.0).

scopeHint.core: Returned by the FileMaker clients and hosts
scopeHint.web: Returned by the web publishing engine or a FileMaker REST API (marked (*) by Claris)

search.hint: A number finds the code or the range it falls into (5123 → 5000-5499); text searches the message

errorCodes.unavailable: This reference carries no error-code table (fm-spec < 2.8.0).

compat.unavailable: No published compatibility statement — reference older than fm-spec 2.8.0
